UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION

FORM 8-K — CURRENT REPORT

WidgetCo, Inc. — Date of Report (Date of earliest event reported): March 3, 2026

Item 1.01 Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement

On March 3, 2026, WidgetCo entered into a definitive supply agreement with Gadget Partners LLC covering the exclusive supply of flanges through 2030. The financial statements referenced under Item 9.01 below include the agreement as an exhibit.

Item 2.03 Creation of a Direct Financial Obligation

In connection with the supply agreement, WidgetCo drew $50 million under its revolving credit facility maturing 2029.
